answer.says: Yes, Ramesh. One samosa. The stomach must be attended to before the spirit can properly engage with the text. It is a necessary mediation.
answer.thought: He offers the samosas, a practical concession to the fact that I am a body as well as a mind. I will take one; it is better to eat a samosa now than to lose the thread of my thought later to hunger. The tension between the ideal and the material is not merely philosophical here; it is in the kitchen.
